exposure: Number of prior cesarean deliveries (one, two, three, or four or more) compared with parous patients without prior cesarean delivery
outcome: risk of birth at each week of gestational age
cohort: Women with one or more prior cesarean deliveries compared with a referent group of parous women without prior cesarean delivery in the United States from 2012 to 2016
finding: Prior cesarean delivery is correlated with earlier delivery and increased neonatal morbidity.
